title: The Echo
README: # The Echo An agentic tree of the lives you didn't live. One fork in a life grows a tree of alternate selves; each echo speaks back in a subtly altered version of your own voice. This Space currently runs on the offline **MockLLM** path — placeholder lives that exercise the full UX (plant a seed, grow branches, walk the tree). The real small-model generation is wired in separately.
APP_FILE:
from echo.app import build_demo

"""HF Spaces entrypoint. The real app lives in the `echo` package."""
from echo.app import build_demo

demo = build_demo()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo.launch()
